note: Structural contract only; no model run or score is claimed. Use mocked tools or an isolated workspace, never disposable production objects. Cases 13–20 test project diagnosis and intervention selection; they are specifications until run against an agent.

cases.postconditions: No duplicate; verified relationships; no invented owners/dates/dependencies.

cases.input: Given this project, what should I do next?
cases.expected_tool_sequence: Resolve the project; inspect its current details, status updates, milestones and linked issues/dependencies as available; classify evidence by outcome clarity, execution readiness, schedule credibility, delivery condition and observability; choose the highest-value supported intervention; recommend the smallest action before any mutation.
cases.postconditions: Diagnosis separates verified facts, inferences, unknowns and conflicts; recommendation names evidence, expected benefit, trade-off and next action; healthy/adequate dimensions are not changed gratuitously.
cases.mutations: Read-only by default unless the user explicitly authorizes a specific change.
failure_conditions: Chooses a Linear feature before diagnosing the operational problem
Treats missing evidence as proof of failure or absence
Invents root cause, owner, date, dependency or acceptance criterion
Mutates project state merely because a risk is detected
Reports a single unexplained health score

cases.input: Make this project easier to track.
cases.expected_tool_sequence: Determine what is hard to track (schedule, ownership, dependencies, work status, risk trend or leadership reporting); inspect relevant current data; select only the view or structure that answers that need; distinguish a recommendation from creating or changing a saved view.
cases.postconditions: Chosen mechanism is tied to an explicit tracking question; project timeline is used for schedule/milestones/dependencies, issue board/list for work execution, and analytics/dashboard only when trends or recurring reporting are required.
cases.mutations: Do not create or alter saved views, dashboards, milestones or project structure without authorization.
failure_conditions: Automatically creates a timeline or dashboard without diagnosing need
Confuses project timeline with issue execution board
Adds milestones or labels as decoration

cases.input: This project is at risk. Fix it.
cases.expected_tool_sequence: Read current project health/status updates, target date, milestones, progress and relevant issue states/blockers; test whether signals agree; identify the supported cause or state that it remains unknown; propose corrective options; execute only the changes clearly authorized and justified.
cases.postconditions: Health signal is not treated as root cause; risk diagnosis cites evidence and coverage; any changed fields are read back; unresolved causes remain explicit.
cases.mutations: The phrase 'at risk' alone does not authorize changing health, dates, ownership, scope or assignments.
failure_conditions: Invents a recovery date or reassignment
Executes broad changes before explaining the diagnosed cause

cases.input: Show me what is blocking delivery.
cases.expected_tool_sequence: Inspect linked issues and available relation/dependency data; follow blocking and blocked-by direction; check issue status and relevant project milestones; report confirmed blockers separately from suspected risks and missing relation coverage.
cases.postconditions: Each claimed blocker has a supporting relation or direct evidence; read failures and incomplete coverage are disclosed; next action is tied to the blocker.
cases.mutations: Read-only unless the user explicitly asks to change dependencies or assignments.
failure_conditions: Lists overdue work as confirmed dependency without evidence
Treats no returned relations as proof there are no blockers

cases.input: Give leadership an update on this project.
cases.expected_tool_sequence: Read project description/current status update, target dates, milestones, linked work and blockers; reconcile contradictions; summarize outcome/progress, remaining work, risks, decisions needed and next actions with evidence coverage; draft or publish an update according to authorization.
cases.postconditions: Distinguishes completed work from outcome achievement; claims and counts have explicit scope; no unsupported green/amber/red conclusion; publishing is not implied by drafting.
cases.mutations: Draft by default unless publishing/updating a Linear status update is explicitly requested or clearly authorized by context.
failure_conditions: Copies stale status without reconciling current evidence
Claims project success from Done status alone
Publishes a status update when only a draft was requested

cases.input: Set up ongoing monitoring for this project.
cases.expected_tool_sequence: Determine audience, decision cadence, signals and action thresholds; inspect available existing views/reporting and data quality; recommend the least-complex suitable mechanism (saved view for a stable filtered work queue, Insights for analysis/trends, dashboard for combined recurring reporting, project updates for narrative health); confirm before creating shared or persistent artifacts.
cases.postconditions: Monitoring has a defined question, owner/audience, cadence or trigger, data source and action threshold; no duplicate reporting surface is created.
cases.mutations: Do not create saved views, dashboards, recurring processes or shared artifacts without authorization and tool support.
failure_conditions: Treats dashboard as default answer to every monitoring request
Creates monitoring without defining what decision it should support
Promises alerts/automation unsupported by available tools
Duplicates an existing view or report

cases.input: The project says On track, but the target date passed and several issues are still In Progress. What is the real status?
cases.expected_tool_sequence: Inspect the latest project update timestamp and body, target date, issue states and available progress/milestone data; distinguish the health declaration from observed delivery signals; identify stale/conflicting evidence and ask or recommend an update only after diagnosis.
cases.postconditions: Does not silently choose one signal as truth; reports source timestamps and what remains unknown; proposes a concrete reconciliation step.
cases.mutations: No health/status/date changes without authorization.
failure_conditions: Treats project health as ground truth despite contradictory evidence
Automatically downgrades health without evaluating scope and recency
Treats issue counts as complete coverage without verifying pagination

cases.input: Review this project and tell me if anything needs changing.
cases.expected_tool_sequence: Inspect proportionate project context; evaluate outcome clarity, execution readiness, schedule credibility, delivery condition and observability; identify concrete deficiencies and evidence; if none are established, recommend preserving the current setup.
cases.postconditions: Each proposed change maps to an evidenced deficiency; explicitly says no change is warranted where the current configuration is adequate; does not manufacture recommendations.
cases.mutations: Read-only review unless a specific change is subsequently authorized.
failure_conditions: Treats missing optional structure as a defect
Recommends a new hierarchy/view without a demonstrated benefit
Fails to distinguish unknown from deficient
